# ==============================================================================
# Spec-driven sensor library (header-only)
#
# The component is born from sensor/apex_data.toml: .auto/ holds the
# spec-generated structs and command dispatch (regenerated by make
# cdef, pinned by check-cdef); inc/ holds the once-generated,
# user-owned stub carrying the model logic. Both directories are
# include roots so generated and hand code share plain-name includes.
# ==============================================================================

include(apex/All)
apex_module(apex_spec_demo_sensor)

apex_add_interface_library(
  NAME
  ${LIB_NAME}
  INC
  "${INC_DIR}"
  DEPS_INTERFACE
  system_core_system_component
  utilities_helpers
  fmt::fmt
)

# The spec-generated headers are a second include root so generated and
# hand code share plain-name includes. Wrapped for the export set the
# helper installs the target into, and installed beside the inc/ headers
# so an installed tree compiles the same way.
target_include_directories(
  ${LIB_NAME} INTERFACE $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.auto>
)
install(DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.auto/" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}")

apex_add_data_manifest(MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apex_data.toml")
